ios.desc:
Patterns is your personal analytics tool to build better habits and achieve your goals.

"We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit."

Join thousands of users who rely on Patterns to improve themselves by getting deep insights into the person you are -- and setting goals to become the person you want to be. Tracking health and fitness goals, keeping up good studying or practice habits, or even remembering special moments, Patterns can help record and keep track of your routines and behaviors.

Why Patterns?

Flexible Goals: Set specific targets like once a week, three times a month, or every day.
Custom Data: Track metrics that matter to you for deeper insights.
Progress Visuals: See your habits and achievements come to life with clear visuals.
Streak Motivation: Keep your momentum going with a streak counter that counts each time you meet your goal.

Actively developed with many new features coming soon.  Let us know what you'd want to see!

Start analysis today and make excellence your habit!
